title: sorghum subglabrescens
intro: Sorghum subglabrescens, commonly known as Broom Corn, is a type of plant that belongs to the sorghum family. It has been found to have several health benefits, including the potential to lower blood sugar levels and aid in the management of diabetes. The therapeutic actions of Broom Corn include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents present in Broom Corn include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
